Strawberry Orange Jam
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 9, 2009 - 11:25pm

Ingredients




1 1/2 pts. strawberries
1 tablespoon grated orange rind
1/4 cup chopped orange sections (1 med. orange)
4 cups sugar
2 tablespoons lemon juice
1 pkg. Certo fruit pectin

Preparation

1 Steam and crush strawberries. Combine 1 1/2 cups berries with orange rind and sections. Stir in sugar; let stand 10 minutes. Mix lemon juice and fruit pectin. Add to fruit; stir 3 minutes. Ladle at once into containers; cover. Let stand 24 hours, then refrigerate up to 3 weeks or store in freezer. Makes 5 cups. 2 Use containers, one pint or less, with tight lids. Wash and scald or use dishwasher with very hot water.
